gizmo.title: Pakuhi radar
gizmo.description: Pakuhi radar (pūnāwelewele) no nā kumu hoʻohālike oʻo a me ka helu ʻaoʻao, e like me HEOSAT. Komo pū he kikokikona pani a me ka papa ʻikepili.

configure.title: Poʻo inoa
configure.description: Poʻo no ka pakuhi; hoʻohana pū ʻia ma ke ʻano he inoa hiki ke komo.

configure.title: Helu kiʻekiʻe loa
configure.description: Ka waiwai kiʻekiʻe loa ma ka pālākiō.

configure.title: Nā māhele
configure.description: Hoʻokahi māhele ma kēlā me kēia laina. Pono he 3 ma ka liʻiliʻi loa.

configure.title: Nā helu
configure.description: Nā helu i hoʻokaʻawale ʻia me ke koma, hoʻokahi no kēlā me kēia māhele ma ke kaʻina like.

configure.title: Nā helu pahuhopu
configure.description: Nā helu i hoʻokaʻawale ʻia me ke koma, hoʻokahi no kēlā me kēia māhele ma ke kaʻina like.

configure.title: Hōʻike i ke kī
configure.description: Hōʻike i kahi kī e kapa ana i nā helu a me nā pahuhopu.

configure.title: Paʻapū
configure.description: Pakuhi liʻiliʻi aʻe me ka ʻole o nā lepili, ke kī a i ʻole ka papa ʻikepili. E lele ma luna o kekahi kiko e ʻike i kona mau waiwai.

advanced.title: Lepili helu
advanced.description: Lepili kī a me ka papa no nā helu.

advanced.title: Lepili pahuhopu
advanced.description: Lepili kī a me ka papa no nā pahuhopu.
